SRC-230:R001.text: START/CONTINUE ordering is deterministic: new actionable ingress routes through START before CONTINUE

SRC-230:R002.text: Recorded user intent cannot masquerade as a claimed work item: USER_REQUEST_RECORDED reports work_claimed=false and preserves active ticket ownership

SRC-230:R003.text: STOP has a documented and regression-tested execution boundary: handback-only semantics, mutation_authorized=false

SRC-230:R004.text: Unsupported host-level enforcement is reported honestly: distinguish mechanical boundary from advisory/unavailable host tool cancellation

SRC-230:R005.text: Runnable work is HUSH-compliant within supported enforcement surfaces: discretionary progress narration suppressed by default

SRC-230:R006.text: Detailed reports preserve information while respecting delivery contracts: use typed artifacts with bounded canonical chat digests
